titolo: Kids Coloring Pages Bundle, 6 Printable PDF Coloring Books, 144 Pages, Christmas Dinosaur Space Ocean Pirate Fairy Tale, Ages 4-8
descrizione:
Six printable coloring books in one bundle, 144 big and simple pages for little artists: Christmas with Santa and his reindeer, pirates and a treasure island, friendly dinosaurs, astronauts and rockets in space, whales and sea turtles under the sea, and a fairy tale world with castles, unicorns and a little dragon. Thick, clear outlines and large areas make every page easy and relaxing to color, and each book starts with a THIS BOOK BELONGS TO page, ready for a name.

WHAT YOU GET
- 6 coloring books in 1 PDF in US Letter (8.5 x 11 in) and 1 PDF in A4 (21 x 29.7 cm)
- 150 pages: 6 full-colour covers + 144 black and white coloring pages, one big illustration per page
- Themes: Christmas, pirates and treasure island, dinosaurs, space and astronauts, under the sea, fairy tales
- 300 DPI, thick clear outlines, easy to color for kids aged about 4 to 8

HOW IT WORKS
This is a digital download: no physical item will be shipped. After payment, download the files from your Etsy account (Purchases) and print them at home or at a print shop on plain white paper, as many times as you like for your own family.

PERSONAL USE ONLY: please do not resell, share or redistribute the files or the printed pages.

Prefer a ready printed book? Each book is also available as a printed soft cover coloring book, made in the USA: see our Coloring Books section.
